description: Triggers an action, such as booking a ticket, paying, or viewing a package.

guidelines.onePrimary: Use only one primary button per screen (for example "Pesan Tiket" or "Bayar").
guidelines.shortVerbs: Write labels as short verbs: "Pesan Tiket", "Bayar Sekarang", "Lihat Paket".
guidelines.accentText: The accent (orange) button always uses dark text — white text on orange does not have enough contrast.

variants.title: Variants
variants.description: Primary for the main action, accent for promos, tonal for secondary actions, outline and ghost for supporting actions, destructive for dangerous actions.

withIcon.title: With Icon
withIcon.description: Place an icon before or after the text. The icon size follows the button size automatically.

iconOnly.title: Icon Only
iconOnly.description: A square button that contains only an icon. An aria-label is required.

loading.title: Loading
loading.description: Disable the button and add a spinning icon while the action runs.

asLink.title: As Link
asLink.description: Use asChild to make a link (<a> or <Link>) look like a button.

props.size: Size of the button. The icon-* sizes are for buttons that only contain an icon.
props.asChild: Applies the button styles to the child element (e.g. <a>) instead of rendering a <button>.
props.native: Button also accepts every native <button> attribute, such as onClick, type and aria-*.
